name: MCW Big Chrome Wurld Chimpionchip
epitaph: The promotion's top singles title, changing hands at its own January 1999 pay-per-view when a short in a mount's control harness sent the challenger crashing down for the pin.

name: Pipsa© "Special" Chimpionchip
epitaph: A title that changed hands when the reigning champion failed to appear for a title defense and a stand-in was pinned in under a minute.

name: King Goofy Stip - Lord of the Pants
epitaph: A novelty title whose matches carry a stipulation drawn at random; it changed hands on a split judges' decision at the promotion's own January 1999 pay-per-view.

name: MCW Super Dooper Keen Team Things
epitaph: The promotion's tag title, won at its January 1999 pay-per-view by two members of a three-man stable after their opponents' own manager interfered and drew a double disqualification the previous month.
